checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Matte black bottle with the same cap stays recognizable, though it appears to get squatter when zoomed.

must.item: Bottle visibly turns about a quarter turn
must.why: A featureless cylinder shows no visible rotation. The motion is a push-in zoom.

must.item: Bottle upright, no melting or proportion change
must.why: It stays upright, but by the end it looks shorter and wider because of the close crop and perspective. The base is cut off.
The camera pushes in strongly, so the bottle is enormous by the end and the table moves.
The clip is square 640x640 and 5 s. Audio is not mentioned. Length is close enough.

faults.what: The camera pushes in heavily instead of circling or turning the bottle, so the result does not match the requested or claimed motion.
The bottle is cropped at the base and top, and its proportions look distorted at the end.
The assistant claims the camera circles the bottle, but the clip shows a zoom.

summary: The clip is a clean but heavy push-in on the bottle, not a turn or orbit, so the bottle ends up cropped and looking squat.
